title: Difficulty Calibration Execution Plan
source: S835 Difficulty Distribution Scan + S839 Upgrade Cohorts
status: PLAN — Ready for execution. Calibration requires pack file writes (Difficulty+DifficultyScore field changes).

primary_issues: DL-031: ~500 definition-match items labeled Moderate (3) — should be Easy (1)
DL-032: 420 case items uniformly Moderate — zero calibration
Massive Difficult deficit: 113 vs target 635 (-522 items)
Zero Very Difficult items: 0 vs target 254 (-254 items)
Moderate surplus: 1,228 vs target 762 (+466 items, mostly DL-031 inflated)

actions.description: Items where stem is a textbook definition and correct answer is the term being defined. Currently labeled Moderate(3) or Moderate-Easy(2). Recalibrate to Easy(1). CognitiveLevel typically Remember or Understand. This is an accuracy fix — these items never required Moderate cognitive demand.
actions.pattern: Stem: '[textbook definition of concept X]' → Correct Answer: '[term for concept X]'. Lexical overlap between stem and correct choice > 50%. Distractors are definition-level alternatives, not application-level traps.
actions.risk: MEDIUM — batch identification may misclassify some items. Per-item stem review required.
actions.governance: Rule 4 (answer-key WARN): CorrectChoice unchanged, difficulty label only.

actions.action: Case Study Recalibration: Break uniform Moderate labeling
actions.description: 75 cases × 6 items avg = ~420 items, all labeled Moderate. Select 45 items (10.7% of case pool) for recalibration based on cognitive demand: 15 Easy (definitional/recall case items), 15 Difficult (multi-exhibit analysis items), 15 Moderate-Easy (simple calculation items).
actions.difficulty_change: Moderate(3)→Easy(1): 15 items; Moderate(3)→Moderate-Easy(2): 15 items; Moderate(3)→Difficult(4): 15 items
actions.risk: LOW — case items already reviewed in certification waves. Per-item difficulty assessment is straightforward.

Easy_1.note: Surplus increases (569→1084) — this is correct. DL-031 items were NEVER Moderate.

Moderate_3.note: Drops from 1,228→698. Now closer to 30% target.

segment_wave_1.name: Cognitive Upgrade Recalibration — Concurrent with S839 Cohort Execution

actions.action: Upgrade candidate difficulty promotion: Moderate→Difficult for Analyze upgrades
actions.description: S839 Cohorts A+B: 70 items being upgraded from Apply to Analyze. These items already require multi-step analysis. Promote difficulty from Moderate(3) to Difficult(4) to match the elevated cognitive demand.
actions.risk: LOW — cognitive upgrade to Analyze justifies difficulty promotion. Stage 5 verification ensures alignment.

actions.action: Existing Difficult inventory: verify labeling accuracy
actions.description: Review all 113 existing Difficult(4) items for labeling accuracy. Some may be Moderate over-labeled (DL-031 pattern on Difficult items). Correct any misclassifications.
actions.difficulty_change: Difficult(4)→Moderate(3): estimated ~10 items. Net: no change to Difficult count.

Moderate_3.note: Drops further as 100 items promoted to Difficult.

Difficult_4.note: Grows from 113→213. Still far from 25% target (635).

segment_wave_2.name: Content Creation — Net-New Higher-Difficulty Items
segment_wave_2.description: The difficult/very-difficult deficit cannot be closed by recalibration alone. The pool simply does not have enough items with complex, multi-step, or judgment-based content. New items must be authored at Difficult and Very Difficult levels.

actions.action: Author Difficult items via S836 pipeline (Sprint 2)
actions.description: Net-new items authored at Difficulty=4. These are Analyze-level items with multi-step calculations, comparative frameworks, and interpretation requirements. The S836 pipeline's Stage 2 (Stem) will be designed for Difficult-level complexity from the start.
actions.source: S836 Sprint 2: 160 Analyze items (many at Difficult) + Sprint 3 items

actions.action: Author Very Difficult items via S836 pipeline (Sprint 3)
actions.description: Net-new items authored at Difficulty=5. These are Evaluate-level items requiring judgment under ambiguity, trade-off assessment, multi-framework decisions, and extended business scenarios. The 10 R-series Evaluate candidates from S839 Cohort C are the prototype.
actions.source: S836 Sprint 3: 100 Evaluate items (subset at Very Difficult)

Easy_1.note: Pool grows to 3,062 items. Easy pct drops from 42.7%.

Moderate_3.note: Below target (30%) — correct, this tier was inflated by DL-031.

VeryDifficult_5.note: First Very Difficult items. Still far from 10% target (254).

target_path_to_full_alignment.description: Full CAQS §6.1 alignment requires additional content beyond Wave 2.

target_easy.note: Oversupply cannot be reduced without archiving items — not recommended.

target_path_to_full_alignment.note: Full alignment of Difficult and Very Difficult tiers requires Sprint 4 (Part 2 expansion). CAQS targets are aspirational for a mature pool; the immediate objective is to eliminate the 0% Very Difficult and grow Difficult from 4.4% to ≥15%.

immediate_segment_batches.focus: Pack A DL-031 Moderate→Easy (Section B: budget definitions)
Pack B DL-031 Moderate→Easy (Section F: technology definitions)
Pack C DL-031 Moderate→Easy (Section E: control definitions)
Pack D DL-031 Moderate→Easy (Section E: control definitions)
Pack E DL-031 Moderate→Easy (Sections A-F: definitional items)
Remaining DL-031 items across all packs

execution_batch_plan.governance_compliance: All batches ≤28 items. Rule 4 (answer-key WARN) applies — difficulty label changes only, no CorrectChoice changes.

governance.rule_4_answer_key_warn: All calibration actions change Difficulty/DifficultyScore only. No CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, or ExplanationWrong changes. Rule 4 WARN applies — REVISION_HISTORY.md entry required per batch.
governance.backup_protocol: Mandatory before any pack file write per AGENTS.md §3.
governance.risk: MEDIUM — batch identification of DL-031 items requires per-item stem review. Automated regex-based identification has false-positive risk.
